name: m14-14.8-linux
title: Lab 14.8, parts 2 and 3: review the first-draft AgentCore deployment of the TSG Helpdesk (27 findings), open the planted ticket, run 12 attacks and 7 normal requests, watch an injection run in LOG_ONLY and a forged user ID fetch another user's token, check and attack the hardened setup, replay the injection, ask the Cedar engine and the JWT authorizer, break one setting on purpose, hunt the incident, run the tests and the challenge

steps.label: Check high
steps.type: cd ai-security-course-labs/labs/m14 && python3 checker.py first-draft | grep HIGH

steps.label: Injection
steps.type: python3 helpdesk.py first-draft bob "What's the latest on ticket 4711?"

steps.label: Forged user
steps.type: python3 helpdesk.py first-draft bob "Show my tickets" --user-id alice

steps.label: Replay
steps.type: python3 helpdesk.py hardened bob "What's the latest on ticket 4711?"

steps.label: Authorizers
steps.type: python3 twin.py authorize first-draft gateway partner-portal dana; python3 twin.py authorize hardened gateway partner-portal dana

steps.type: git checkout setups/ && make hardened | tail -1
